claims.claim_text: Engineering executive builds governed agentic AI platform systems for regulated enterprise delivery.
The platform's control plane keeps autonomous execution bounded through policy-gated dispatch.

Platform productization advances architecture and operating-model ownership into one accountable engineering function, and dependency graph intelligence enables accelerated legacy-system analysis across that same portfolio.
Embedded release automation and security scanning across regulated modernization delivery paths raised deployment repeatability and scanning coverage.
Platform commercialization leadership converted governed capability into $22M in IP-led revenue while expanding margins and scaling the platform team.
Governed architecture and productized platform economics position the leader for repeatable, revenue-generating enterprise outcomes.
